learning: Connector permission failure is a stateful blocker, not a permanent capability claim. Close it only after the authorized migration ledger and independent production schema readback agree. Separately preserve empty-table or missing-business-evidence states as BUILT_NOT_PROVEN rather than treating schema recovery as full business proof.
prevention: Do not keep a recovered permission blocker open after exact migration plus schema readback proves recovery.
Do not promote empty persisted services to operationally proven merely because their schema exists.
Separate platform capability recovery from business/runtime coverage proof.
